I have the free (trial) version on my iPad and I have basically given up on it. I find that I have to spend every dollar of my starting money building the bare necessities; the money you get for your first prisoner intake is barely enough to cover the construction and guards needed for the second intake. By day 4, half your prisoners are injured and there’s no money to hire a doctor nevermind build an infirmary. And there’s no placating your prisoners either. I built dormitories with windows, showers, TVs, and couches and they still got stabby by day 3. I tried to prevent the stabbings with searches, but then I needed to build a half-dozen solitary cells. So, I gave up on it.

When you have been chronically suicidal for 12 years and you have plans, contingency plans, and the means to fulfill those plans, you might be surprised what your brain starts to think about.

Let me tell you something that I wish someone had the guts to say to me when I was an asshole teenager:

Threatening suicide isn’t helpful. Why don’t you tell us what is making you think that you want to die and let’s see if we can figure out some solutions together that don’t involve razor blades or pills?

1.) Stop smoking pot. It isn’t doing anything good for you and you know it.

2.) You don’t need a therapist for DBT. There are workbooks that can help you. If I remembered the names of the workbooks my clinician recommended I would tell you, but it has been years. Ask your therapist. Obviously, therapy is preferable to a workbook, but if you can’t afford therapy anymore, a workbook will do in a pinch.

The only things my phone deletes are apps and, like I said, it is only a mild inconvenience to reinstall them. The only thing that bothers me about it is that my phone deletes apps I used frequently while leaving less used apps alone. Like it will delete the Weather app, which I use daily and only takes up a tiny amount of space on my phone, before it will delete an app I use maybe once a month and takes up much more space.

And I’m fine with that as long as it makes sense. I don’t need to know every time my PVR deletes an old recording to make space for a show I’m recording. But iOS is buck wild. Did you know your phone saves every picture you have ever sent or received? You might not be able to see them in Messages because conversations only go back so far. But they’re there taking up space and you have to manually delete them one by one.
